purpose: Compare three D6 options on the recorded sizing basis of 374 scored rows and 26 scored positives: the gate-filtered vector at an unchanged 49 calls, the pre-registered monotone extension to the top 94 rows, and holding the deployed vector. Each option is simulated exactly rather than linearised, with a scored-fraction sensitivity and the probability that the extension yields a decisive outcome; read-only, no candidate or upload

options.gate_filter: Replace the lowest-gate calls at an unchanged count of 49
options.extension_94: Pure monotone extension of the deployed vector to the top 94 rows
options.hold: Send nothing; the board keeps displaying the latest submission

added_precision_notes.base_rate: the blind scored prevalence implied by the published aggregates
added_precision_notes.offline_mixture_ratio: deployed realised precision 11/28 scaled by the ratio of the offline mixture precision of ranks 50-94 to that of ranks 1-49 (0.133 / 0.197)
